# ankra_cluster_agent_resources (Resource)

The CPU and memory the cluster's Ankra agent requests and is limited to. The counterpart of `ankra cluster agent resources set`. Only the attributes set in configuration are written. The platform stores each quantity in its canonical spelling; the configured spelling is kept while it means the same quantity. Destroying the resource returns each quantity the configuration has set to the chart default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_agent_resources" "agent" {
  cluster_id     = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
  memory_request = "256Mi"
  memory_limit   = "1Gi"
  cpu_request    = "100m"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `cpu_limit` (String) CPU limit, for example `1` or `500m`. A Kubernetes quantity; an empty string uses the agent chart's default. Unset, the platform's value is kept and reported.
- `cpu_request` (String) CPU request, for example `100m`. A Kubernetes quantity; an empty string uses the agent chart's default. Unset, the platform's value is kept and reported.
- `memory_limit` (String) Memory limit, for example `1Gi`. A Kubernetes quantity; an empty string uses the agent chart's default. Unset, the platform's value is kept and reported.
- `memory_request` (String) Memory request, for example `512Mi`. A Kubernetes quantity; an empty string uses the agent chart's default. Unset, the platform's value is kept and reported.

### Read-Only

- `apply_state` (String) How the last write reached the agent: `applied`, `pending_upgrade`, `agent_offline` or `not_set`.
- `id` (String) The cluster id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by cluster id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_agent_resources.agent 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666
```
